prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout adoption certificate redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate step using a grid layout that displays companion artwork side-by-side with certificate attributes.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is ready! Review their certificate details before bringing them to your desktop."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop control guide completion screen: Add a dedicated controls guide screen at the end of onboarding explaining hotkeys and tray options to manage the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_guide"]}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive pet style choice cards on story screen: Add interactive style selection choice cards to the story screen preceding path selection.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Preview Pet Styles", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after waiting progress screen: Move sign-in step to take place immediately after the waiting screen right before home intro presentation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet restoration copy: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that logging in saves current pets and restores previous companions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets", "body": "Logging in connects your new pet companion to your account and restores any existing pets automatically."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout for path selection screen: Switch the choose_path screen to a compact layout presenting path options clearly without extensive vertical scrolling.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Path", "body": "Select whether to pick a classic pet companion or build a custom friend from your photos."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Animated loading mascot on waiting screen: Add an animated progress asset component to the waiting screen during desktop mascot environment generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:mascot_loader", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "progress", "label": "Preparing desktop animations...", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] Card layout for custom pet photo upload: Rebuild the photo upload screen using a structured card layout with photo guidance tips.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo", "body": "Upload a clear, front-facing photo of your pet for best custom rendering results."}}
8: [finish, hint] System tray shortcut hint on home intro: Add a hint box on the home intro screen explaining system tray access to hide or manage desktop pets.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet in the system tray to change settings, summon, or temporarily hide your desktop pet."}}
9: [home, redesign] Split layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout displaying setup status on one side and desktop feature overviews on the other.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Preparing Your Companion", "body": "We are setting up your pet's desktop engine and loading animation assets."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning adoption certificate layout within onboarding is allowed and preserves screen function.
The sign_in step was omitted from the onboarding sequence order.
Adding preview choice cards to the story screen is an allowed onboarding enhancement.
Reordering the sign_in step after waiting is explicitly permitted under onboarding rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to explain pet saving and restoring is allowed and maintains the screen's core job.
Compact layout preserves the choose_path job of offering both adopt and create paths.
Adding animated progress components to the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.
Card layout redesign for the photo upload step is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a hint box to home_intro is permitted as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Split layout redesign for the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.
